description: Native VNC and RDP viewer for Windows with file transfer and adaptive video quality.
pre_install: $binary = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'MyVNC-*-amd64.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $binary) { throw 'MyVNC release executable was not found.' }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -NewName 'MyVNC.exe'
notes: MyVNC has signed in-app updates. Use Scoop as the update authority to avoid concurrent updates.
